summary: Idaho Copper Corp filed an 8-K regarding a private offering of convertible promissory notes and warrants. The company issued $1,357,947 principal amount of notes convertible at $6.00 per share, with warrants to purchase 226,332 shares at $7.50 per share. Two investors converted existing notes into the offering. The transaction is a capital-raising event under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b), not a special situation. No tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special-situation elements are present; it is an ordinary equity-linked financing.
